name: Floral and Hardy
description: Floral and Hardy on Skippack Pike is the garden center you drive to when you want something alive, not a plastic bouquet.

hero.headline: Plants, pots, and a yard that looks loved
hero.sub: Floral and Hardy on Skippack Pike is the garden center you drive to when you want something alive, not a plastic bouquet.

story.heading: A garden center with dirt under the nails
paragraphs: We grow and stock what does well here, then tell you how to keep it alive. That is the whole offer.
Come walk the benches. If you are unsure, ask. We would rather send you home with the right plant.
Floral and Hardy serves people who live and work in Skippack.
You'll find the phone and the next step on this page, not buried in a menu.
Come in when you're ready. We'll make the visit straightforward.
Neighbors already know the name. The site should make the first visit easy.

feature.heading: Skippack Pike, in season
feature.text: The mix changes with the weather. Spring is busy. Fall is for the people who plan. Winter still has something green if you ask.

spotlight.heading: 4007 Skippack Pike
spotlight.text: Park, wander, and leave with more than you meant to. That is a good day here.

contact.heading: Come walk the benches
contact.sub: Confirm hours before you drive. The address is on this page.
